title: Behemoth
lead: Behemoth, "the Beast", is the great grass-eating creature God shows Job in Job 40:15–24, "the first of the ways of God". Readers have seen in it the hippopotamus, the elephant, a primeval monster, or a real animal drawn with mythic weight. Later Jewish writings pair it with Leviathan as the two monsters kept for the last days (1 Enoch 60:7–9; 4 Ezra 6:49–52; 2 Baruch 29:4).
